page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz, with 64.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core) and a 35 MB L3 cache. The server includes 959 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps, running on a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results show average multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 14029.1 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 7338.0. Single-core performance is a notable tradeoff, ranking in the bottom 25% for stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression. However, memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average tier, with Redis SET operations reaching 13.73 million operations per second and static web serving throughput at 11.76 GB/sec.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation, bundled local SSD storage, and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance provides predictable resource density for storage-heavy and database workloads. It is well-suited for database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded processing tasks that benefit from local SSD storage, while being less optimal for single-threaded or compute-heavy workloads that require high single-core performance.
